title: Oven-Smoked Monsoon Venezuelan Dish Wrap
description: A low-sodium, spicy monsoon dish featuring red pepper flakes in a crispy corn husk wrap. Perfect for a quick snack or lunch.

ingredients.name: Red Pepper Flakes
ingredients.notes: For added heat, use more or less to taste.

ingredients.name: Monsoon Venezuelan Cheese Blend
ingredients.notes: Use a dairy-free alternative if needed.

ingredients.name: Monsoon Venezuelan Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Use a dairy-free alternative if needed.

instructions: Season the chicken breast with low-sodium salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Wrap the corn husk in foil and bake for 10 minutes to crisp it up.
While the husk is baking, mix the monsoon Venezuelan cheese blend, garlic powder, and monsoon Venezuelan spice blend in a bowl.
Add the shredded chicken to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Remove the husk from the oven and fill it with the chicken and cheese mixture.
Drizzle with lime juice and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Place the wrap under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a minute or two before serving.
